_about: Music for RHIZOMORPH, generated locally with MusicGen medium through ComfyUI (tools/audio/gen_music.py). MusicGen caps a clip at 30 s; loop tracks get trailing quiet trimmed and their tail crossfaded into the head. status: todo / review / keep / redo. Put picked files in this folder as <name>.wav.
